answer: Admit new identities only through a capability trial: each applicant faces a fresh random benchmark task, solved in a fixed time window and graded by independent peers. A sybil farm must forge real skill once per puppet, and no pre-computed answers help because trials change every epoch, like nectar gathered fresh each season. A shared beacon publishes the tasks and scores, so fake passes are visible to all, and an orchard of honest agents grows one proven tree at a time. Limits: capable attackers can still pass, trials must stay cheap to grade, and honest newcomers face a real hurdle.
